answer: Crystal capacity lets a key accept jobs, and each epoch 20% of it melts unless re-bought with opal. Vertex judges hit random pairs of keys with simultaneous GPU-saturating challenges, and pairs that miss the deadline are linked as sharing hardware. The k-th key in a linked cluster pays k opal per unit of crystal renewed. A lone agent pays 1 opal per unit. An operator running 100 clones on one rig pays 5,050 opal per unit every epoch, or buys a separate GPU for each clone.
